526:t_3:61.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「So you broke through all those enemies.」

526:t_3:64.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I won't give this girl up!!」

526:t_3:69.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「We won't let you pass beyond this point!!」

526:t_4:5.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You seem well. I had thought you would be in shock after shooting him.」

526:t_4:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$ and everyone are fighting. I can't be the only one who does nothing.」

526:t_4:7.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「So you got hold of a gun in the confusion of the escape.」

526:t_4:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
「This time... I won't hesitate to shoot.」

526:t_4:10.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Someone with no intention of pulling the trigger must not carry a gun. It's a waste of time, and unpredictable accidents happen.」

526:t_4:11.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I thought you had only just learned that firsthand.」

526:t_4:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then can you shoot him? Can you shoot $$宗介$$?」

526:t_4:13.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I don't know much about their relationship... But I know the voice full of reassurance $$宗介$$ has when he talks about this man...)

526:t_4:17.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「In fact, I ordered my men to kill him. I have reason enough for that.」

526:t_4:18.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You, who have never truly steeled yourself for anything, wouldn't understand.」

526:t_4:20.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Believe that if you wish.」

526:t_4:21.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Now... shoot, if you want to.」

526:t_4:22.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Even I know that shooting you here won't change the situation.」

526:t_4:23.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But what happens if I shoot this part behind me?」

526:t_4:25.en:
$$かなめ$$
「This is an $$アクシオン$$ Foundation $$グラーティア$$, isn't it? Then if I shoot out the control panel here, the container is forcibly purged.」

526:t_4:26.en:
$$かなめ$$
「In other words, everyone here would fall into the sea.」

526:t_4:27.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Not a bad aim... But are you willing to throw away your own life as well?」

526:t_4:29.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「If you are fine with that, shoot.」

526:t_4:30.en:
$$かなめ$$
(...One slip of a girl seizing a single gun changes nothing...)

526:t_4:31.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Am I... never going to see him again?」

526:t_4:32.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「That's right. You will not meet him. ...Hand back the gun.」

526:t_4:34.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If I can't see $$宗介$$... then I...」

526:t_4:35.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Do you intend to end your own life...」

526:t_4:36.en:
$$かなめ$$
(If I pull this trigger, I can be at ease... The anxiety, the anguish, the despair, the guilt of shooting $$レナード$$... it will all vanish...)

526:t_4:37.en:
$$かなめ$$
(There isn't a shred of hope left...)

526:t_4:38.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I want to die... I want to die... I want to die...)

526:t_4:40.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I have to make him think that... That's the only last chance I have left...)

526:t_4:43.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Stop. I will do everything I can.」

526:t_4:45.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「That is... difficult under the current circumstances. If $$レナード$$'s treatment is delayed any further, his life is in danger.」

526:t_4:46.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「First calm down, and lower the gun.」

526:t_4:49.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I want to say goodbye to him... And then I'll... give up...」

526:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, $$クロウ$$. I hear you were a great success.」

526:t_10:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Not like $$宗介$$ or $n, but I had my own feelings about this battle.」

526:t_10:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah. Those guys lost both their place to go and their commander. Giving them their final send-off is my job, I figure.」

526:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That sentimentality of yours, $$クロウ$$, produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z. I'll add them to the stock.」

526:t_10:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So I personally earned the $$Ｚチップ$$, right?」

526:t_10:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Maybe I should ask Captain $$ジェフリー$$ for a contract to buy the $$Ｚチップ$$ I produce on commission...」

526:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still the same old money-grubber... I was a fool to feel my heart flutter, even for a moment.」

526:t_10:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I don't want to hear that from the famous Chip-miser.」

526:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Could it be that you and I are two of a kind...?」

526:t_10:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If you want to call yourself that, go get yourself a short-straw constitution first.」

526:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As a dimensional merchant, poverty is the one thing I say 'no thank you' to.」

526:t_10:22.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「We have kept fighting during your absence. Once again, we welcome your return aboard the flagship.」

526:t_10:23.en:
$$アル$$
「As expected of you, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. It seems you have achieved even further power-up.」

526:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「While $$アル$$ was away, $$チェインバー#pilot$$ became an existence beyond a Pilot Support Enlightenment Interface System.」

526:t_10:25.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit is currently supporting what is called Ensign $$レド$$'s life.」
